lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate 2 to flange 3, 90 deg fold. The sections at 5/25/50/75/95% show a clean radius, with the label on the outer apex (median 0.10 mm to the nearest surface point). The line runs the full ~80 mm flange length.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange 3 to strip 8, the 28 deg first bend of the offset pair. The sections show a formed radius, with the label on the outer-skin apex the whole way along. It spans the full 80 mm strip.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Strip 7 to lip 5, the 44 deg second bend of the offset pair. The flat ~4 mm strip between B2 and B3 is clear in the sections. The label is on the outer apex and the line runs end to end along the strip. The lip ears beyond it are coplanar, not part of this fold.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Flange 3 to end wall 9, 90 deg fold with a smooth radius in every section. The label is on the outer apex. The line runs from under the plate down to the relief at B2, which is the full ~14 mm of visible fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Flange 3 to end wall 10, the mirror of B4 at the other end. The radius is clear, the label is on the apex and the line runs from the plate down to the relief notch.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: End wall 12 to eared tab 16, 90 deg. Together with B4 it forms an S-step, so the tab ends up roughly parallel to the lip. The sections show a real formed radius, and the label sits on the outer apex. The line spans the tab root from relief to relief (~13 mm).

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: End wall 11 to eared tab 14, the mirror of B6. The radius is visible in all sections and the label is on the apex. The line covers the full tab root, relief to relief.
